items.title: Practice Doppel switching
items.description: In solo play, learn to select each hero and reposition the full team.

description_i18n.en: In solo play, learn to select each hero and reposition the full team.
description_i18n.pt: No modo solo, aprenda a selecionar cada herói e reposicionar a equipe inteira.

items.details: Inactive Doppels do not follow you automatically. Move each one deliberately, leaving it on safe ground or a required switch before selecting another. For a long crossing, assemble the team into a Totem, transport it, then separate it at the destination. When a puzzle needs an item you left behind, switch to that item’s bearer rather than trying to solve everything with the currently selected hero. Check that all three reach the Triforce gateway before advancing.

details_i18n.en: Inactive Doppels do not follow you automatically. Move each one deliberately, leaving it on safe ground or a required switch before selecting another. For a long crossing, assemble the team into a Totem, transport it, then separate it at the destination. When a puzzle needs an item you left behind, switch to that item’s bearer rather than trying to solve everything with the currently selected hero. Check that all three reach the Triforce gateway before advancing.
details_i18n.pt: Os Doppels inativos não seguem você automaticamente. Mova cada um de propósito, deixando-o em terreno seguro ou sobre um interruptor necessário antes de selecionar outro. Para uma travessia longa, reúna a equipe em um Totem, transporte-a e separe-a no destino. Quando um desafio exigir um item que ficou para trás, troque para seu portador em vez de tentar resolver tudo com o herói selecionado. Confira se os três alcançaram a passagem da Triforce antes de avançar.

items.title: Practice Totem formation
items.description: Learn how height, carrying and throwing affect the three heroes' reach.

description_i18n.en: Learn how height, carrying and throwing affect the three heroes' reach.
description_i18n.pt: Aprenda como altura, transporte e arremesso afetam o alcance dos três heróis.

items.details: The bottom hero controls the Totem’s movement, while the hero at the top can use an item at the stack’s height. Build the order around the tool needed next, not only the nearest hero. Throwing the top portion of a stack lets you reach elevated ledges, but it can also strand the required item on the wrong side. Before throwing, identify the landing area and how the remaining hero will cross or retrieve the others.

details_i18n.en: The bottom hero controls the Totem’s movement, while the hero at the top can use an item at the stack’s height. Build the order around the tool needed next, not only the nearest hero. Throwing the top portion of a stack lets you reach elevated ledges, but it can also strand the required item on the wrong side. Before throwing, identify the landing area and how the remaining hero will cross or retrieve the others.
details_i18n.pt: O herói da base controla o movimento do Totem, enquanto o herói do topo usa um item na altura da pilha. Organize a ordem conforme a ferramenta necessária a seguir, não apenas pelo herói mais próximo. Arremessar a parte superior da pilha permite alcançar plataformas elevadas, mas também pode deixar o item necessário do lado errado. Antes de arremessar, identifique o local de chegada e como o herói restante atravessará ou recuperará os companheiros.

items.description: Complete the area's boss encounter and inspect the newly opened regional choices.

items.details: Lure Margoma into striking an obstacle, then use the opening to throw a Bomb into its hollow top. Once the eye is exposed, throw an upper hero onto the boss and attack it. As Margoma grows taller, rebuild the Totem to match the new height before trying another bomb throw. Keep the lower heroes away from its charging path while preparing the stack; rushing into the spikes only drains the shared health.

details_i18n.en: Lure Margoma into striking an obstacle, then use the opening to throw a Bomb into its hollow top. Once the eye is exposed, throw an upper hero onto the boss and attack it. As Margoma grows taller, rebuild the Totem to match the new height before trying another bomb throw. Keep the lower heroes away from its charging path while preparing the stack; rushing into the spikes only drains the shared health.
details_i18n.pt: Atraia Margoma para atingir um obstáculo e aproveite a abertura para lançar uma Bomb em seu topo oco. Quando o olho ficar exposto, arremesse um herói de cima sobre o chefe e ataque. Conforme Margoma fica mais alto, refaça o Totem para alcançar a nova altura antes de tentar lançar outra bomba. Afaste os heróis inferiores da trajetória das investidas enquanto prepara a pilha; avançar contra os espinhos apenas consome a vida compartilhada.

items.details: A Water Rod pillar is a temporary platform, not a permanent bridge. Place it where it connects the current ledge to the next reachable height, then move the needed heroes before it expires. In solo play, prepare the waiting Doppels near the crossing first so you spend less time switching. Remember that stacking heroes changes the height from which an item is used; inspect raised targets before assuming a ground-level shot is sufficient.

details_i18n.en: A Water Rod pillar is a temporary platform, not a permanent bridge. Place it where it connects the current ledge to the next reachable height, then move the needed heroes before it expires. In solo play, prepare the waiting Doppels near the crossing first so you spend less time switching. Remember that stacking heroes changes the height from which an item is used; inspect raised targets before assuming a ground-level shot is sufficient.
details_i18n.pt: A coluna do Water Rod é uma plataforma temporária, não uma ponte permanente. Posicione-a onde conecte a plataforma atual à próxima altura alcançável e mova os heróis necessários antes que desapareça. No modo solo, deixe os Doppels perto da travessia antes de criá-la para gastar menos tempo nas trocas. Lembre-se de que empilhar heróis altera a altura de uso do item; observe alvos elevados antes de presumir que um disparo do chão será suficiente.

items.details: Use the Gripshot to pull the smaller eyes away, then strike the separated targets rather than attacking the protected center. Adjust your Totem height when the remaining eyes are out of ground-level reach. Once the protective eyes are gone, form the taller stack needed to strike the exposed central weak point and follow the stun with sword attacks. Reposition between openings instead of staying stacked directly in the boss’s path.

details_i18n.en: Use the Gripshot to pull the smaller eyes away, then strike the separated targets rather than attacking the protected center. Adjust your Totem height when the remaining eyes are out of ground-level reach. Once the protective eyes are gone, form the taller stack needed to strike the exposed central weak point and follow the stun with sword attacks. Reposition between openings instead of staying stacked directly in the boss’s path.
details_i18n.pt: Use a Gripshot para puxar os olhos menores e ataque os alvos separados em vez do centro protegido. Ajuste a altura do Totem quando os olhos restantes ficarem fora do alcance do chão. Depois de remover os olhos protetores, forme a pilha mais alta necessária para atingir o ponto central exposto e aproveite o atordoamento para golpear com a espada. Reposicione-se entre as aberturas em vez de manter o Totem diretamente na trajetória do chefe.

items.details: During the moving-cart encounter, deal with the Hinox’s bombs before they accumulate around the heroes. Catch the thrown bombs and toss them back into the enemy cart; the Boomerang can stun the Hinox while you prepare. Prepare the next item bearer before the dangerous section rather than repeatedly rebuilding a Totem in a cramped cart. Keep watching the track and recover the team’s formation between waves.

details_i18n.en: During the moving-cart encounter, deal with the Hinox’s bombs before they accumulate around the heroes. Catch the thrown bombs and toss them back into the enemy cart; the Boomerang can stun the Hinox while you prepare. Prepare the next item bearer before the dangerous section rather than repeatedly rebuilding a Totem in a cramped cart. Keep watching the track and recover the team’s formation between waves.
details_i18n.pt: Durante o encontro nos carrinhos em movimento, lide com as bombas do Hinox antes que se acumulem perto dos heróis. Pegue as bombas lançadas e arremesse-as de volta no carrinho inimigo; o Boomerang pode atordoar o Hinox enquanto você se prepara. Prepare o próximo portador de item antes da seção perigosa em vez de reconstruir repetidamente um Totem no carrinho apertado. Continue observando os trilhos e reorganize a equipe entre as ondas.

items.details: Watch the color of Moldorm’s eyes to identify the hero it is pursuing. Lead it away from the others, then use a different hero to strike the vulnerable tail. In solo play, spread the Doppels around safe parts of the arena and switch deliberately to create that opening. The tail rises as the fight progresses, so use two- and then three-hero Totems to reach it. Avoid chasing the head or backing the inactive heroes toward a drop.

details_i18n.en: Watch the color of Moldorm’s eyes to identify the hero it is pursuing. Lead it away from the others, then use a different hero to strike the vulnerable tail. In solo play, spread the Doppels around safe parts of the arena and switch deliberately to create that opening. The tail rises as the fight progresses, so use two- and then three-hero Totems to reach it. Avoid chasing the head or backing the inactive heroes toward a drop.
details_i18n.pt: Observe a cor dos olhos de Moldorm para identificar o herói perseguido. Afaste-o dos companheiros e use outro herói para atingir a cauda vulnerável. No modo solo, distribua os Doppels em partes seguras da arena e faça trocas planejadas para criar essa abertura. A cauda sobe conforme a luta avança; use Totems de dois e depois três heróis para alcançá-la. Evite perseguir a cabeça ou empurrar os heróis inativos em direção às quedas.

items.details: Use the Magic Hammer to strike Blizzagia’s armored head until its icy mask breaks. Once the weak point is exposed, follow up with sword attacks. The Fire Gloves can hit the serpent’s body to help replenish energy while you prepare the hammer bearer for another opening. Watch where the serpent travels and reposition before it reaches the team. On slippery ground, approach in controlled steps; a poorly placed Totem makes avoiding its next pass harder.

details_i18n.en: Use the Magic Hammer to strike Blizzagia’s armored head until its icy mask breaks. Once the weak point is exposed, follow up with sword attacks. The Fire Gloves can hit the serpent’s body to help replenish energy while you prepare the hammer bearer for another opening. Watch where the serpent travels and reposition before it reaches the team. On slippery ground, approach in controlled steps; a poorly placed Totem makes avoiding its next pass harder.
details_i18n.pt: Use o Magic Hammer para atingir a cabeça protegida de Blizzagia até quebrar sua máscara de gelo. Quando o ponto fraco ficar exposto, ataque com a espada. As Fire Gloves podem atingir o corpo da serpente para ajudar a repor energia enquanto prepara o portador do martelo para outra abertura. Observe o trajeto da serpente e reposicione a equipe antes de sua aproximação. No chão escorregadio, avance com passos controlados; um Totem mal posicionado dificulta desviar da próxima passagem.

details_i18n.pt: Contra o Margoma de estimação, busque uma Bomb Flower com o Boomerang, lance-a na abertura superior e mande um herói até o olho exposto. Contra o Arrghus de estimação, forme um Totem alto com o portador da Gripshot no topo e puxe o olho central durante uma abertura. Os olhos menores de fogo e gelo podem ser atordoados com o Boomerang e golpeados para removê-los caso precise deixar a arena mais segura.

items.details: Each of the three colored orbs must be struck by its matching hero. Arrange the team so you can switch colors without rebuilding from scratch after every opening. When all three orbs are damaged, the boss becomes vulnerable: throw a hero onto it and attack the exposed eye. Later openings require greater height, so rebuild the Totem to reach the raised targets. Stop attacking with the wrong color and reposition when the remaining orb is out of reach.

details_i18n.en: Each of the three colored orbs must be struck by its matching hero. Arrange the team so you can switch colors without rebuilding from scratch after every opening. When all three orbs are damaged, the boss becomes vulnerable: throw a hero onto it and attack the exposed eye. Later openings require greater height, so rebuild the Totem to reach the raised targets. Stop attacking with the wrong color and reposition when the remaining orb is out of reach.
details_i18n.pt: Cada uma das três esferas coloridas precisa ser atingida pelo herói da cor correspondente. Organize a equipe para trocar de cor sem reconstruir tudo após cada abertura. Quando as três esferas forem danificadas, o chefe ficará vulnerável: arremesse um herói sobre ele e ataque o olho exposto. As aberturas posteriores exigem mais altura; refaça o Totem para alcançar os alvos elevados. Pare de atacar com a cor errada e reposicione-se quando a esfera restante estiver fora do alcance.

items.details: During the opening, use a two-hero Totem to throw an attacker onto the central platform when Maud leaves an opening. Later, arrange the stack around the colored parasols: the contacting hero must match the parasol, while white ones are neutral. Pay attention to the middle hero when throwing the top two together. As Maud rises, use the full Totem and the lifting parasols to reach her. After victory, take the three Lady materials to Madame Couture, craft the Lady’s Ensemble and return to the castle to finish Styla’s rescue.

details_i18n.en: During the opening, use a two-hero Totem to throw an attacker onto the central platform when Maud leaves an opening. Later, arrange the stack around the colored parasols: the contacting hero must match the parasol, while white ones are neutral. Pay attention to the middle hero when throwing the top two together. As Maud rises, use the full Totem and the lifting parasols to reach her. After victory, take the three Lady materials to Madame Couture, craft the Lady’s Ensemble and return to the castle to finish Styla’s rescue.
details_i18n.pt: No início, use um Totem de dois heróis para arremessar um atacante à plataforma central quando Maud abrir uma oportunidade. Depois, organize a pilha conforme os guarda-sóis coloridos: o herói em contato deve combinar com a cor; os brancos são neutros. Observe a cor do herói do meio ao arremessar os dois superiores juntos. Quando Maud subir, use o Totem completo e os guarda-sóis que se elevam para alcançá-la. Após a vitória, leve os três materiais da Lady a Madame Couture, crie o Lady’s Ensemble e volte ao castelo para concluir o resgate de Styla.

items.details: With the update that adds the post-story vendor option installed, finish the rescue of Princess Styla and inspect the Street Merchant’s changing stock for Friendly Tokens. details_i18n.pt: Com a atualização que acrescenta a opção do vendedor após a história instalada, conclua o resgate de Princess Styla e confira o estoque variável do Street Merchant em busca de Friendly Tokens. Isso oferece aos jogadores solo uma forma de obter trajes que usam essas fichas sem partidas online oficiais. Não confunda Friendly Tokens com Hero Points nem suponha que as antigas instruções multijogador sejam o único método. Confira o estoque real em vez de esperar uma ficha garantida em toda visita.
